evidence_class: independent point-observation source for conditional positive-location recovery, not confirmed native occupancy, absence, movement, colonization or rescue

eligibility_precommitted.taxa: exact v1.193 provisional eligibility whitelist only; no re-entry based on ALA events
eligibility_precommitted.islands: exact 167 frozen one-to-one matched heldout island IDs only
eligibility_precommitted.record_date: eventDate must begin with a 4-digit year from 2000 through 2026 inclusive followed by end of token, separator or T; missing/unparseable excluded
eligibility_precommitted.source_fid_and_species_pair: exact numeric ALA_FID and normalized strict binomial match; no taxonomic synonyms
eligibility_precommitted.deduplication: one positive candidate per (species, original heldout island), regardless of ALA record count

conditional_positive_location_score.denominator: for each focal species and each frozen predictor model, sum clipped predicted p over exactly the same 167 matched islands
conditional_positive_location_score.case_loss: -log q_model(island,species) on unique valid ALA positive pairs only
conditional_positive_location_score.primary_P1: mean over eligible species of within-species mean[AlaPositiveLoss(C_actual) - AlaPositiveLoss(R3)]
conditional_positive_location_score.secondary_P2: mean over eligible species of within-species mean[case loss(C_actual) - average_j case loss(C_rewired_j)]
conditional_positive_location_score.source_of_training_responses: original IUCN-polygon-derived pilot labels; completely frozen
conditional_positive_location_score.reason_for_normalization: a uniform increase in a model's presence probabilities across all 167 islands cannot by itself improve its score

uncertainty.cluster: species with >=1 valid distinct ALA positive pair, equal species weight
uncertainty.joint_support: P1 < 0 AND 95% upper(P1) < 0 AND P2 < 0 AND 95% upper(P2) < 0
uncertainty.if_P1_only: independent positive-location information but no supported unique original-graph advantage
uncertainty.if_nonsupport: report with no repair or secondary rescue

limitations: ALA is a spatially uneven presence-record sample, not a designed island-wide census
lack of ALA record cannot be interpreted as absence
some recorded species may be translocated rather than native on a particular island
eventDate year verifies dated detection only, not an entire island population or colonization event
a positive result is independent-observation location allocation, not proof of dispersal or habitat connectivity
the original reference and original graph both encode physical geography
no new mammal training or heldout response decoding is allowed

canonical_outputs.per_species_artifact: stored as Actions artifact, not an eligibility-changing input
